propositions: autodeploy.sh uses a single global deployed-sha marker for two independent components (review-bot and mcp blue-green), causing premature redeployment of completed components on early script exit
a single shared deploy-backoff file throttles both review-bot and mcp failures, causing mcp failures to suppress bot deployments and vice versa
components skipped by backoff windows are incorrectly stamped as deployed in the footer, permanently dropping pending changes for skipped components
per-component completion markers (bot-deployed-sha and mcp-deployed-sha) must be written mid-tick when each component deploys, with per-component delta gates re-pointed to their own markers
per-component backoff state (separate mcp-deploy-backoff file) allows one component's failure to throttle only itself while the other continues deploying on the same tick
per-component incompleteness flags (bot_incomplete and mcp_incomplete) prevent backoff-skipped components from being marked deployed when changes are still pending
